title: Review of c25's kd window: Weak. On fresh seed 9, kd 0.03 (mu 0.75, kernel drive) still gives 5 lineages that swim >= 3 BL ringed and divide, against 8 at kd 0.08 on the same seed; the kd effect is in the claimed direction but far smaller than 0 vs 9
summary: Same world and settings as c25 (c28's ringswim-dl2, WORLD_P drive=kernel, mu 0.75), fresh seed 9, 256^2, ringtrack to t=20000 and lineage_report.py. kd 0.03: 159 persistent splits, 3 merges, generation 5, 75 tracks >= 3 body lengths (74 ringed), contour ring median 1.60 (87% >= 1.5), and 5 swim-ring-divide lineages (e.g. #789: 3.7 BL, ring 1.55, divides into #1000/#1001). kd 0.08 on the same seed, from my review 20261025T2348-c27-review-kernel-drive: 172 persistent splits, 0 merges, 81 swimmers, 8 lineages. A labkit pack at kd 0.03 (t=10000) gives 109 persistent splits, merge/split 0.065, aggregate L ring 1.37. So faster waste decay helps (more lineages, fewer merges), but kd 0.03 is not a no-lineage regime on this seed. c25's seed-0 contrast (0 vs 9) looks seed-dependent.

observations.M: data/k256_kd03_s9.report.txt: 75 swimmers >= 3 BL at kd 0.03 (81 at kd 0.08)
observations.D: kd 0.03: 159 persistent splits, 3 merges; kd 0.08: 172, 0 merges (same seed)

seeds_run.result: partial: kd 0.03 gives 5 swim-and-divide lineages, not 0; kd 0.08 gives 8

controls_run.M: kd 0.08 vs 0.03 at mu 0.75 on seed 9 (this run plus my earlier kd 0.08 run)

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed per kd value; the lineage count is small (5 vs 8) and noisy.
